definitions.locality_turnout_rate: sum(total_vote_turnout) / sum(total_registered_voters), only when every precinct numerator and denominator is present
definitions.locality_precinct_coverage: Full JSON locality votes and CSV precinct-detail sums are shown at their own grains; the difference is a coverage measure, not a forced reconciliation.
definitions.contest_choice_summary_status: NO_STATEWIDE_SUMMARY is expected for choices without a statewide counterpart in the source; their locality totals remain available.
definitions.missing_values: Blank source counts remain null; they are not treated as zero.

interpretation: Use locality_results for full locality-level candidate or ballot-choice totals. Use the M3 results table for precinct detail. Turnout rates are available only where both the reported turnout numerator and registration denominator are present; incomplete locality totals are left null. A missing statewide summary for a local contest is expected and is not a failed reconciliation.
